map.按门襟受力与美观，常 8–12 cm；厚呢料可加密防豁口。: Considering placket stress and appearance, 8-12 cm is typical; heavy wool can use closer spacing to prevent gaping.
map.拉链为什么要留余量？: Why leave extra length on a zipper?
map.上止/下止需咬合空间，拉链过短拉不到头或暴口，一般比开口长 2–5 cm。: The top and bottom stops need engagement space; a zipper that is too short will not reach the end or will burst open, so it is generally 2-5 cm longer than the opening.
